name: Complex Nutrition
description:
AI-assisted code disclaimer: the code, data and documentation in this mod were written with AI assistance (Anthropic's Claude), under human direction and review. Please report anything that looks or plays wrong.

Gives every vanilla food real-world calories, macronutrients, vitamins and minerals (per USDA FoodData Central). Shows them in item tooltips and keeps a reserve of each nutrient that fills as you eat and drains over time, in place of the five vanilla food group bars. Diet effects come in later versions.
